reviews.text: Angie is so lovely! She is responsive, reliable, and so good with our cats 😻

Angie is simply put just the best at this job. While I was away I really appreciated (and looked forward to) the pictures and detailed updates on how my senior girl was doing. She is reliable, tidy and most importantly genuinely loves and understands cats! My senior cat is shy, and like many shy cats needs time and space to decide if a new human is a friend. She warmed up to Angie so quickly. If you want complete peace of mind while you’re away, look no further.

I am a cat sitter too. When I'm booked or out of a service area I refer clients to Biscuit Queen. Her standard of care, attention to detail, communication and admiration of felines is on par with my own. She is my go to sitter for cats requiring an additional helping hand(s) with medicine administration.

Angie was truly the best cat sitter we could have asked for. From the moment we left, I felt completely at ease knowing our cats were in such caring, trustworthy hands. She is incredibly communicative, reliable, attentive, and genuinely cares about the animals she looks after. She kept us updated regularly, was always quick to respond, and went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect.

It’s rare to find someone you fully trust with your pets and home, but Angie exceeded every expectation. Our cats were happy, comfortable, and clearly very loved while we were away. She was thoughtful, helpful, dependable, and made the entire experience stress-free. I honestly can’t recommend her enough — if you’re looking for someone kind, responsible, and amazing with cats, Angie is absolutely the person to book.

A+++ . we’ve been working with angie for so many years and trust her whole heartedly with our two cats. She is not only great at taking care of them — but also in her attention to the upkeep around the home. We are so grateful to work with her. 😻

Highly recommend her cat-sitting services! The booking process is smooth and professional & prices are very reasonable. She cares about safety and comfort for your cats. Directions were followed to the T & she provided immediate thorough updates and pics. She also went above and beyond and washed their bowls & kept everything neat and tidy. Will be using again!

Angie is nothing short of incredible. She goes above and beyond with my two kitties! From sending very detailed updates, to cleaning their box and water bowl better than I do, to ensuring my wanna be escape artist cat doesn’t get out. I don’t know what I’d do without her. I always know when I’m out of town my babies are in the best hands. HIGHLY recommend

Angie is a blessing! She is professional and reliable. Every time I’m out of town I know I don’t have to worry about anything because she takes such good care of my babies 🐱 my favorite part is when she sends pics of them while I’m away! It’s such a relief to know they are safe and taken care of. She cleans the litter, plays with them, and refills food+water. I would give her 10 stars if I could ✨

Angie has been our cat-sitter several times now (for short weekends and for longer extended vacations), and she is simply the best! We have two senior cats with very specific food and medication needs, and she always takes such great care of them. She sends us daily updates and pictures, so we never have to worry while we're away. Our kitties love Angie!

Biscuit Queen Cat Sitting is one of the good ones for sure! We're another pet care provider in a different locale than BQCS, but we have nothing but great things to say about their services.

Their owner, Angie, truly cares about the pets in her care, and she's so dedicated to improving her craft and learning - It's an inspiration to us as well.

We're blessed to have Angie as a pal in the industry and can wholeheartedly recommend her services. You're in great hands with Biscuit Queen Cat Sitting - They are responsible sitters, reasonably priced, professional, and best of all: They absolutely LOVE cats!

We trust Angie with our cats every time we travel, and I can't recommend her highly enough. She's incredibly communicative, reliable, and truly gives us peace of mind while we're away. She's also fantastic with cats who have medical needs. We feel so lucky to have found her!

Angie was fantastic! I really appreciated her daily updates and photos as well as her gentleness with our shy cat. By the end of our trip CatCat was waiting for her by the front door and happily enjoying pets! Will definitely hire Angie for our next trip.
Angie is excellent!! She is very professional and goes the extra mile. She is genuinely nice, and made me feel that my babies were loved and taken care of. I’m soooooo happy I found her 🤍 …

Nothing but positive things to say about Angie and her services. She’s been taking care of boys for almost two years, if not longer. She’s accommodating and flexible and a great communicator. Our boys love her so much. One time when she came to pick up keys the boys were confused why she was there with us at the same time. She’s quite literally one of their humans now. We’ve left our boys while one of them was ill, needed medication, wearing a cone and a not so pleasant experience. We were going to cancel the trip or have one of us not go. She reassured us that it would be fine and she would take the utmost care of him. Again, nothing but positive things to say. And the fact you get check ins and photos is a cherry on top! She has definitely eliminated our concern/anxiety about leaving for any amount of time. Couldn’t recommend Angie enough. 10+ stars!!
Angie is the best! My cats love her and I can trust her completely. Highly recommend!

Angie is the best! I have two cats with very different personalities—one is super shy and the other is very social—and she has charmed them both. When I have to leave my boys, I always trust that they are in good hands because Angie gives super thorough daily updates and responds quickly if I have any questions. She also goes above and beyond cleaning up any kitty messes and making sure that the house is tidy when I return.

I strongly recommend Angie for anyone in need of a catsitter!

Angie has been sitting for my cat for years, and there’s no one I’d trust more. Communication is clear and easy, she’s able to mange my senior cat’s med schedule, and most importantly, I always come home to a very happy and well cared for cat. There’s nothing more reassuring when I’m away than getting photos of my cat snuggled up on Angie’s lap getting some love. Thank you, Angie!!

When we need care for our little fur baby, Biscuit Queen Cat Sitting is the only company we trust. Angie is so experienced and knowledgeable about all things cats.  I feel at ease knowing that my kitty is getting all the love, attention, and care that she needs while I'm away. Angie takes the time to make sure plenty of pictures and videos are sent to me and follows specific instructions to a T.
Your cats are in good hands with Angie! :)

We absolutely love Biscuit Queen! Angie is so great with our two cats and we feel completely comfortable any time she’s taking care of them, knowing they’re getting lots of attention and our care & feeding instructions are being followed exactly. You’ll be happy you hired her. She’s the BEST.
